parent_objective: generate corrected public pilot configs before training
blocked_by: M1206 fixes corrected pilot protocol but committed configs for current-tiled controls do not yet exist
supersedes: running corrected pilot from ad hoc temporary configs
invalidates: training corrected controls without config contract checks

public_gates: M1207 may generate configs and run config/runtime checks only
M1207 must not run candidate replay
M1207 must not use private holdout
M1207 must not claim profile superiority or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim performance evidence from configs
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes current-tiled and corrected-reset profile configs under the M1206 protocol
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if current-tiled configs do not preserve actor capacity
stop if reset-control config cannot express every-step eval semantics
stop if config checks require hidden or oracle inputs
stop if generated configs differ in reward or env distribution
fallback_plan: route to runtime repair if current-tiled config checks fail
route to evaluator repair if reset semantics cannot be represented
route to corrected pilot run if config smoke passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1206 corrected pilot design requires materialized configs before training

admission_evidence: M1206 fixes corrected profile set and budget
M1204 runtime smoke passes corrected controls
blocked_shortcuts: do not make performance or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: next corrected smoke or pilot run is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1207 materializes controls for later current-frame substitution tests but does not itself produce self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Config generation only; later pilot may evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If configs cannot express corrected controls cleanly, route to implementation repair instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Corrected profile configs can be generated under the M1206 protocol without hidden inputs or training.
success_criteria: corrected configs are generated or a focused blocker is recorded
no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next corrected smoke or pilot-run milestone is selected
failure_criteria: configs omit current-tiled controls or corrected reset semantics
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
generated configs change reward/env distribution unfairly

commands.name: generate_corrected_profile_configs
commands.command: materialize corrected profile configs and run checks without training

decision_rule: M1207 passes if corrected configs are materialized and checked without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or claim expansion.
